# Lean Shared Memory

Maintain lightweight notes that survive the next task without becoming noise.

## Keep

- Commands and flags that actually worked in this stack.
- Invariants that broke once and must hold forever after.
- Tool behaviors that changed results (ordering, hosts, quoting).

## Drop

- Generic tutorials unrelated to this repo.
- Duplicate facts already obvious from version history.
- Long prose that restates the instruction.

## Update rule

When new evidence contradicts an old line, replace that line. Do not stack contradictory guidance.

## Operating principle

Prove outcomes with the project’s own checks; keep edits minimal relative to the ask.
